description: Runtime health monitoring page showing overall status, model health, Kafka health, diagnostics, performance metrics, and feature flags.

elements.label: Refresh Runtime Health
elements.description: Button that refreshes runtime health data.
exampleUserQuestions: show me the refresh button on runtime

elements.label: Runtime Summary (Overall Status)
elements.description: Card showing overall runtime health status, version, and key feature flags.
exampleUserQuestions: show me the diagnostics card here

elements.label: Persona Enabled
elements.description: Card showing whether persona feature is enabled or disabled.

elements.label: Evidence Payload Enabled
elements.description: Card showing whether LLM evidence payload feature is enabled.

elements.label: Artifact Base Path
elements.description: Card showing the artifact base path for the runtime.

elements.label: LLM in Data Processor
elements.description: Card showing whether LLM explanation is enabled in the data processor.
exampleUserQuestions: is llm in data processor enabled

elements.label: Sequence Model (Fallback Mode)
elements.description: Card showing the current sequence model fallback mode.

elements.label: Model Health
elements.description: Card showing the health status of all machine learning models including artifact status, inference, and availability.

elements.label: Diagnostics Section
elements.description: Section showing diagnostics including field coverage, sequence coverage, tabular coverage, model latency, and benchmark data.

elements.label: Kafka Health
elements.description: Card showing Kafka consumer group health, topic details, partition assignment, concurrency, offset status, and processing metrics.
exampleUserQuestions: take me to the view that i can see the kafka health

elements.label: Idempotency Section
elements.description: Section showing idempotency metrics including duplicate events, sequence appends, alerts, and SQL writes skipped.

elements.label: Performance Section
elements.description: Section showing performance metrics including event processing, model inference, sequence inference, Redis write, and other latency measurements (Avg/P95).

elements.label: Stats Section
elements.description: Section showing live time basis statistics for the runtime.

elements.label: Next Event Prediction Section
elements.description: Section showing next event prediction configuration including enabled status, model, top-K, minimum context events, heads, and feature flags.

elements.label: Session Finalization Section
elements.description: Section showing session finalization metrics including open sessions, explicit end, timeout, max duration, flush counts, and late events.

elements.label: Final Winners Section
elements.description: Section showing the final model winners and recommended approaches for each use case.

elements.label: Reports Table
elements.description: Table showing available runtime reports with name, availability status, generation timestamp, and path.

elements.label: Live Connection Badge
elements.description: Badge showing the SSE live connection status for runtime health.

elements.label: Data Source Chip
elements.description: Chip showing the data source for the runtime health data.
exampleUserQuestions: what is the runtime data source
